issue.title: Athena Prometheus clipster_server scrape job (127.0.0.1:9102) is permanently down

task_type_fields.impact: A permanently down target means "all targets up" can't serve as a health invariant: every verification run has to explain it away, and any future `up == 0` alert would fire forever.
task_type_fields.repro:
On athena, 2026-10-23:

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/targets | python3 -c 'import json,sys; [print(t["labels"]["job"], t["health"]) for t in json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["activeTargets"]]'
# clipster_server down; node/prometheus/pushgateway/rfserver up
ss -ltn | grep ':9102'          # nothing listens
command -v clipster             # not installed
```

The `clipster_server` scrape job (127.0.0.1:9102) in `/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml` can never succeed. The clipster binary is not installed, athena has no X session, and Bryan's user supervisord `[program:clipster]` runs `wait_for_xserver && clipster ...`, which can never start. The job's source copy is now tailnet `hosts/athena/monitoring/prometheus.yml`.

Fix: remove the `clipster_server` job (and the dead `[program:clipster]` entry, if Bryan confirms clipster is retired on athena) from the source. Run `promtool check config`, install through a reviewed `/sase_sudo` gate using the README's install steps, and confirm every remaining target is `up`. Keep 9102 in the nftables drop set or remove it deliberately. Proposed by bob-cli-an.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2). Size small: the root cause is known and the change is one config job.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-an.3 found the clipster_server target can never be up (no clipster binary, no X session) and proposed removing or repairing it.
